messages:
Alex: Heading to the SF office next Fri (Ferry Building / Embarcadero). Any quick lunch recs for a team of 5? Prefer places that can handle a small group and keep it under 40m.
Lina: Hog Island Oyster Co is lovely but can have lines at lunch. Good if you get there early.
Ben: Slanted Door is amazing but slow. If you want local fast + vibes, Boudin has seating and soups.
Priya: El Porteno near the piers does quick empanadas and sandwiches, pretty fast service.
Omar: Super Duper Burgers is quick and reliable for groups. Also Ferry Building Marketplace has lots of stalls (grab-and-go).
Zoe: If you want fancy but fast, try Roli Roti (rotisserie) inside the Ferry Building 1; they move quickly.
Priya: Mini list: ```- Hog Island - oysters, longer waits
- Boudin - sourdough bowls, roomy seating
- El Porteno - empanadas, fast
- Super Duper - burgers, quick
- Roli Roti - rotisserie, quick line```
Link: https://maps.app.link/ferry-eats
CateringBot: FYI we can cater to the SF office if you submit the request 48h ahead: https://redwood.gig/catering. Dietary options available.
Alex: Great, thanks! I'll run a quick poll for preferences and lock something by Wednesday. :thumbsup:
